$doc: What the renderer reports of a frame (pxl-render gpu/renderer.rs): the GPU spans it is timed in,
in the order the renderer encodes them, and the kind of frame it made; the profiler records and reports
$FRAME_KINDS: What the renderer made of a frame turn, where it decides it (pxl-render gpu/renderer.rs `render_frame`, `FrameKind`): `none` before it was asked; `unready` with no device or surface; `held` where the surfaces would block (not admitted); `dropped` where the frame did not fit the GPU stream; `plain` drawn with nothing cast; `standing` drawn on the standing ray lane; `cast` drawn with a cast; `still` drawn over the standing world image, its overlay alone; `stood` where nothing the frame reads changed, so nothing is drawn or submitted and the canvases keep what they show.
